messages:
matt: hit a surprising bug with the python async SDK retry logic today. created resource via streaming body, got a transient 503 mid-stream, sdk retried and server saw two creates. repro below.

anna: yikes. which sdk version and minimal repro?

matt: redwood-python==0.8.2 (async). minimal: 
```py
async def send():
    async with RedwoodClient(api_key=KEY) as c:
        async def gen():
            yield b'{"part":1}'
            await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
            yield b'{"part":2}'
        await c.create_resource(body=gen())
```
server injects 503 between chunks, sdk retries but generator is exhausted so the second request is a fresh create. no Idempotency-Key was present so duplicate created.

sasha: sounds like the retry path assumes body cloning works. async generators are non-rewindable so we must not auto-replay. options: detect non-replayable bodies and skip automatic replay; provide opt-in buffering for small streams; or require explicit Idempotency-Key for create operations that aren't replay-safe.

matt: current code tries to clone body and swallows errors, then proceeds with retry. we should fail-safe to "no automatic retry" when clone not possible and log/telemetry.

anna: propose: 1) detect non-seekable/non-bytes bodies (no seek attr and not bytes/bytearray/str/BytesIO) -> mark non_replayable; 2) add optional buffering flags: allow_buffering=True with buffer_limit=64*1024 to buffer small bodies and allow replay; 3) require/advise Idempotency-Key header for streaming uploads.

sasha: also treat partial responses specially: if server returned some response chunks before the 5xx, assume partial success and do not replay. that avoids duplication on partially-applied operations.

matt: will implement detection + tests that simulate a mid-stream 503. adding unit + integration tests for async generator path.

anna: create an issue and mark P2, add labels: devex, retry, idempotency. include suggested API for buffering and docs note.

ci-bot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/3427 — "py-sdk: avoid unsafe auto-retries for non-rewindable streaming bodies". Labels: devex, retry, p2.

matt: i'll pick this up. plan: patch retry logic to detect non-replayable bodies and return a RetryNotAttempted error path, add telemetry metric `sdk.retry.non_replayable_detected`, and a doc snippet in async streaming guide recommending Idempotency-Key usage.

sasha: SGTM. please include a small example showing how to provide an Idempotency-Key and how to opt-in to buffering.

anna: assigning to @matt. thanks. :thumbsup:

matt: thanks all — will open PR tomorrow and tag for review.
